svg.aria-label: Song press: an n8n AI Agent console (left) feeds a prompt from its hopper into Suno's MCP press — the lit song-disc die stamps the song onto a vinyl disc — and finished discs stack up in the library drum (right). The lit APPROVE lever is the gate before generation, because every song spends Suno credits; the credit dial shows them draining into the orange zone. The key on the plate is the OAuth sign-in: no API key. Verified numbers: Suno's official MCP server at api.suno.com/mcp launched October 28, 2026; the November 6 edit-tools update grew the tool count from 35 to 41 (Claude Code, reported); clients include Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude Code and Cursor.
svg.text: api.suno.com/mcp · OCT 28, 2026 · tools 35 → 41 · no API key
